scenarios.title: Connect a Telegram user session
scenarios.summary: Sign in through a trusted provider with a phone and login code, or confirm a QR login. The provider integration is separate.

scenarios.title: Connect a Telegram Business bot
scenarios.summary: Connect a bot to selected chats with explicit permissions and verify the resulting Business connection.

scenarios.title: Receive owner files through a Telegram bot
scenarios.summary: Configure one owner-only host bot and a separate supervised receiver that saves inert files and replies with their verified local paths.

scenarios.title: Connect with SSH and verify optional VNC transport
scenarios.summary: Reuse a verified SSH route or choose direct, jump or reverse access; optionally verify RFB transport. Desktop viewers are deferred.
